arguments:
set -Eeuo pipefail
export GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 GIT_PAGER=cat PAGER=cat
work=$(mktemp -d /tmp/rea-leads-global-dedup-pr46.XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -rf -- "$work"' EXIT
git clone -q --depth 1 --branch fix/20261031-cross-flow-member-dedup https://github.com/martaxi-boss/telegram-robot-leads.git "$work"
cd "$work"
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "ec32f8b27883fce20c491db4425a210eb2cc5e76"
sudo -n -H /opt/telegram-robot-leads/.venv/bin/python -B -m unittest discover -s tests -q
sudo -n -H /usr/bin/python3 -B - <<'PY'
import ast
from pathlib import Path
paths=['scripts/safe_runtime.py','scripts/organic_growth.py','scripts/leads_operational_report.py','tests/test_safe_runtime_policy.py','tests/test_organic_growth.py','tests/test_leads_operational_report.py']
for path in paths:
 ast.parse(Path(path).read_text())
 print('AST_OK',path)
a=Path('scripts/safe_runtime.py').read_text()
b=Path('scripts/organic_growth.py').read_text()
c=Path('scripts/leads_operational_report.py').read_text()
assert 'stable_id in state["approved_join_requests_done"]' in a
assert 'key in state["approved_user_ids_done"]' in b
assert 'key in state["pending_member_ids"]' in b
assert 'distinct_processed_member_identities' in c
print('SHARED_LEDGER_TESTS_PRESENT')
PY
node --check ecosystem.config.js
git --no-pager status --short
echo PR46_REA_FULL_VALIDATION_PASS
